title: 502s on /checkout after deploy v2.31
symptoms: Alert 'PaymentService 5xx rate > 5%'. 502 errors on POST /checkout. Logs: 'FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections' from Postgres payments-db.
root_cause: Deploy v2.31 doubled gunicorn workers from 4 to 8 per pod but DB_POOL_MAX stayed at 20, exhausting the Postgres connection limit (max_connections=100).
resolution_steps: Confirm exhaustion: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname='payments'
Set DB_POOL_MAX=60 in payment-service ConfigMap
kubectl rollout restart deploy/payment-service
Verify 5xx rate < 0.5% in Grafana dashboard 'payments-overview'
failed_attempts: Restarting pods alone - pool refilled and exhausted again within 3 minutes
lesson: Any deploy that changes worker count must include a DB pool-size review.

title: Connection pool exhaustion again after v2.40
symptoms: Same 'PaymentService 5xx rate > 5%' alert. 502/504 on /checkout and /refund. Postgres log: 'too many connections for role payments_app'.
root_cause: v2.40 raised worker count to 12 per pod; DB_POOL_MAX=60 was insufficient again. Same class of failure as INC-017.
resolution_steps: Check pg_stat_activity connection count per role
Set DB_POOL_MAX=100 and enable PgBouncer in transaction mode in front of payments-db
Rolling restart payment-service
Confirm connections plateau below 80
failed_attempts: Scaling payment-service pods from 6 to 10 - made it WORSE, more connections
lesson: Scaling pods out during pool exhaustion increases connections; fix pooling first. Recurrence of INC-017 - add a CI check on worker_count * pool_size.

title: 502s on /checkout - expired upstream TLS cert
symptoms: Alert 'PaymentService 5xx rate > 5%'. 502 on POST /checkout. NO Postgres errors. Logs: 'x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid' when calling psp-gateway.internal.
root_cause: Internal TLS certificate for psp-gateway.internal expired at 00:00 UTC; cert-manager renewal had failed silently 30 days earlier.
resolution_steps: Verify: openssl s_client -connect psp-gateway.internal:443 | grep notAfter
Force renewal: kubectl delete secret psp-gateway-tls -n payments (cert-manager reissues)
Restart psp-gateway pods to load new cert
Add alert on cert expiry < 14 days
failed_attempts: Followed RB-DB-POOL from INC-017/INC-031 for 12 minutes - irrelevant, DB was healthy
lesson: Same alert, different root cause. Always check logs for the error string before applying the usual runbook.

title: Pool exhaustion after autoscaler tripled pods on sale day
symptoms: 'PaymentService 5xx rate > 5%' during flash sale. Postgres: 'remaining connection slots are reserved'. HPA had scaled payment-service from 6 to 18 pods.
root_cause: HPA scale-out tripled total connections; PgBouncer pool_size not raised to match. Third occurrence of the connection-pool class (INC-017, INC-031).
resolution_steps: Raise PgBouncer default_pool_size 100 -> 250 and reload
Cap HPA maxReplicas to 12 until DB capacity is reviewed
Verify checkout success rate > 99%
lesson: Connection budget must be computed from maxReplicas, not current replicas.

title: Login latency p99 > 8s - Redis evictions
symptoms: Alert 'auth-service p99 latency > 3s'. Users report slow login. Redis INFO shows evicted_keys climbing and used_memory at maxmemory (2GB).
root_cause: New remember-me feature stored 30-day session blobs (~40KB each) in Redis without TTL, filling memory; sessions were evicted and re-created on every request.
resolution_steps: redis-cli INFO memory and INFO stats to confirm evictions
Add TTL: run scripts/backfill_session_ttl.py
Set maxmemory-policy volatile-lru
Raise maxmemory to 6GB as buffer
failed_attempts: Restarting auth-service pods - no effect, Redis was the bottleneck
lesson: Every new Redis key type needs an explicit TTL reviewed in code review.

title: search-api pods OOMKilled every ~40 minutes
symptoms: Alert 'search-api restarts > 5 in 1h'. kubectl describe pod shows OOMKilled, exit code 137. Memory graph is a sawtooth climbing to the 1Gi limit.
root_cause: Memory leak in thumbnail generation: PIL Image objects not closed in image_preview.py after upgrade to Pillow 10.
resolution_steps: Confirm sawtooth memory in Grafana search-api-resources
Hotfix: wrap Image.open in a context manager in image_preview.py, deploy v1.18.1
Temporarily raise memory limit to 2Gi as buffer during rollout
failed_attempts: Raising memory limit to 2Gi alone - only delayed the OOM to ~90 minutes
lesson: Sawtooth memory + periodic OOMKilled = leak, not undersizing. Do not just raise limits.

title: Email/push notifications delayed 45 minutes
symptoms: Alert 'kafka consumer lag notifications-topic > 100k'. Logs flooded with 'Attempt to heartbeat failed since group is rebalancing'.
root_cause: Scaling notification-worker from 3 to 20 replicas at once triggered a rebalance storm; max.poll.interval.ms (300000) exceeded by slow batch handler, causing repeated rebalances.
resolution_steps: Scale workers back to 6
Set max.poll.records=50 and increase max.poll.interval.ms to 900000
Scale up gradually 6 -> 12 -> 20 with 5 minute gaps
Confirm consumer lag trending down
failed_attempts: Restarting the Kafka brokers - unnecessary and caused a 2-minute blip for other topics
lesson: Never scale Kafka consumers by more than 2x at once.

title: 500s for all users - feature flag rolled to 100%
symptoms: Alert 'checkout-web error rate > 20%'. Sentry: 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading total)' in NewCartSummary component.
root_cause: Feature flag new_cart_summary was accidentally set to 100% instead of 10% in LaunchDarkly; the component crashed for carts with promo codes.
resolution_steps: Check recent flag changes in LaunchDarkly audit log
Set new_cart_summary to 0%
Verify error rate drops within 60s (no deploy needed)
failed_attempts: Started a rollback deploy of checkout-web - 14 minutes wasted, the code was fine
lesson: If errors start with no deploy, check the feature-flag audit log FIRST.

title: order-service write failures - disk full
symptoms: Alert 'order-service error rate > 5%'. Logs: 'OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device'. Node disk at 100% on node-pool-b.
root_cause: LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG left enabled after INC-022 investigation; 40GB of logs in 4 days filled the node's ephemeral storage.
resolution_steps: kubectl exec -- df -h to confirm
Set LOG_LEVEL=INFO in ConfigMap and restart
Truncate /var/log/pods/order-service-* on affected node
Add disk usage alert at 80%
lesson: Temporary debug settings need an expiry reminder in the incident ticket.

title: Mobile clients getting 429 Too Many Requests
symptoms: Support tickets: mobile app shows rate limited. api-gateway metrics show 429 spike only for /v2/feed. Config diff shows rate limit 1000 rpm -> 100 rpm.
root_cause: Rate-limit config for /v2/feed was changed from 1000 to 100 rpm by a mistyped Terraform variable in PR #812.
resolution_steps: Compare live Kong rate-limit plugin config with git
Revert PR #812 and apply Terraform
Confirm 429s drop to baseline
failed_attempts: Restarting api-gateway pods - config is declarative, restart changed nothing
lesson: 429 spikes on a single route are almost always a config change, not real traffic.

title: All logins failing after identity-provider key rotation
symptoms: Alert 'auth-service 401 rate > 30%'. Logs: 'JWSError: key with kid=2025-01 not found in JWKS cache'. Users cannot log in on web or mobile.
root_cause: The identity provider rotated its JWT signing key; auth-service caches the JWKS document for 24h and kept validating against the old key set.
resolution_steps: Confirm new kid in https://idp.internal/.well-known/jwks.json
Force refresh: curl -X POST http://auth-service:8080/admin/jwks/refresh
Set JWKS_CACHE_TTL from 24h to 15m in ConfigMap
Verify 401 rate returns to baseline
failed_attempts: Restarting auth-service pods - they reloaded the stale JWKS from the CDN edge cache
lesson: Key rotation must trigger a JWKS refresh; a 24h cache is too long for signing keys.

title: Recommendations p99 12s during Elasticsearch node replacement
symptoms: Alert 'recommendation-api p99 > 5s'. Logs: 'ElasticsearchException: search timed out after 30000ms'. ES cluster status yellow, 140 shards relocating.
root_cause: A node replacement in the ES cluster triggered mass shard relocation; recommendation queries competed with relocation I/O.
resolution_steps: Check GET _cluster/health and _cat/recovery
Set cluster.routing.allocation.node_concurrent_recoveries=1 to throttle relocation
Temporarily reduce recommendation result size 50 -> 20
Restore settings after cluster is green
failed_attempts: Scaling recommendation-api from 4 to 8 pods - Elasticsearch was the bottleneck, latency unchanged
lesson: Throttle shard recovery before replacing ES nodes during business hours.

title: Blank checkout page for Safari users after webpack upgrade
symptoms: Support tickets: blank page on iPhone/Safari. Sentry: "SyntaxError: Unexpected token '?'" in main.bundle.js. Chrome users unaffected.
root_cause: PR #640 upgraded webpack and changed the build target to ES2020, shipping optional chaining unsupported by Safari 13; browserslist config was dropped.
resolution_steps: Reproduce in BrowserStack Safari 13
Restore browserslist ('> 0.5%, last 2 versions, safari >= 12') and rebuild
Deploy checkout-web v4.2.1
Purge CloudFront distribution E1ABC (aws cloudfront create-invalidation --paths '/*')
failed_attempts: Rolling back the deploy without purging the CDN cache - Safari users kept getting the broken bundle for 20 more minutes
lesson: Any frontend rollback must be followed by a CDN purge, or the rollback is invisible to users.

title: Customers charged twice - gateway retry storm
symptoms: Finance reports 212 duplicate charges. api-gateway logs: 'upstream timeout on POST /orders, retrying (attempt 3/3)'. order-service p99 spiked to 9s at the same time.
root_cause: Kong was configured to retry POST /orders on timeout; order-service had no idempotency key, so each retry created and charged a new order.
resolution_steps: Set retries=0 for the /orders route in Kong
Add Idempotency-Key header propagation and dedupe table in order-service
Refund duplicates with scripts/refund_duplicates.py --since 2025-02-22T08:00
Verify duplicate count is zero in orders_dupes view
failed_attempts: Increasing the order-service upstream timeout from 5s to 15s - made the retry storm last longer
lesson: Never retry non-idempotent POSTs at the gateway. Idempotency keys are not optional for payments.

title: Login latency again - Redis full from device-code flow
symptoms: Alert 'auth-service p99 latency > 3s'. Redis used_memory at 6GB maxmemory, evicted_keys rising. Same shape as INC-009.
root_cause: The new OAuth device-code flow stored polling state keys without TTL. Second occurrence of the missing-TTL class after INC-009.
resolution_steps: redis-cli --bigkeys to identify devicecode:* keys
Backfill TTL: scripts/backfill_ttl.py --prefix devicecode: --ttl 900
Add CI lint rule failing any redis SET without EX/PX
Confirm evictions stop
lesson: Code review missed the TTL again; a lint rule is more reliable than a checklist. Recurrence of INC-009.

title: SMS not delivered after Twilio credential rotation
symptoms: Alert 'sms delivery success < 90%'. Logs: 'Twilio 401: Invalid AccountSid or Auth Token'. Email and push unaffected.
root_cause: Twilio credentials were rotated in Vault, but notification-worker reads secrets at startup only and pods were not restarted.
resolution_steps: Verify new credentials with curl against the Twilio API
kubectl rollout restart deploy/notification-worker
Enable vault-agent secret auto-reload in the pod template
Replay failed SMS from the dead-letter queue
failed_attempts: Retrying the failed messages from the DLQ before restarting - all failed again with 401
lesson: A secret rotation is not complete until every consumer has reloaded it.

title: Total outage - all upstreams unhealthy after service-mesh upgrade
symptoms: Alert 'api-gateway 5xx > 50%'. Every response: '503 no healthy upstream'. All backend pods Running but 0/1 Ready.
root_cause: Istio sidecar upgrade to 1.22 changed the readiness probe rewrite path; probes hit /healthz instead of /health/ready and every pod was marked unready.
resolution_steps: kubectl describe pod shows 'Readiness probe failed: 404'
Roll back sidecar injector to 1.21: istioctl install --revision 1-21
Rolling restart all namespaces to pick up the old sidecar
Update probe paths before retrying the upgrade
failed_attempts: Restarting api-gateway pods - they came back unready too, the problem was cluster-wide
lesson: When every service is unready at once, suspect the platform layer (mesh, CNI, probes), not the services.

title: search-api OOMKilled - capacity, not a leak
symptoms: Alert 'search-api restarts > 5 in 1h'. Pods OOMKilled exit 137. Memory graph is a steady climb that tracks request rate, NOT a sawtooth. Traffic doubled after a marketing campaign.
root_cause: search-api was undersized for 2x traffic; heap was dominated by the per-pod query cache. Look-alike of INC-022 but the leak fix from v1.18.1 was already deployed.
resolution_steps: Compare memory graph shape with INC-022 (sawtooth = leak, traffic-correlated climb = capacity)
Raise memory limit 1Gi -> 3Gi and scale 4 -> 8 replicas
Cap QUERY_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES at 5000
Confirm memory plateaus under load
failed_attempts: Spent 40 minutes hunting for a new memory leak with heap dumps - the INC-022 fix was already in place, this was capacity
lesson: Same alert as INC-022, different cause. Read the graph shape before assuming a leak.

title: Stock counts wrong - serialization failures under bulk restock
symptoms: Alert 'inventory-service error rate > 5%'. Logs flooded with 'ERROR: could not serialize access due to concurrent update'. Some SKUs show negative stock.
root_cause: The new nightly bulk-restock job ran at SERIALIZABLE isolation and collided with checkout stock decrements; retries were exhausted and some writes were lost.
resolution_steps: Pause the restock CronJob: kubectl patch cronjob bulk-restock -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'
Switch the job to READ COMMITTED with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED in batches of 500
Backfill stock from the warehouse ledger: scripts/reconcile_stock.py
Re-enable the job outside peak hours
failed_attempts: Raising the retry count from 3 to 10 - increased contention and made checkout slower
lesson: Bulk jobs that touch hot rows must use row-level locking in batches, never SERIALIZABLE over the whole table.

title: 429s on /v2/search - wrong Terraform workspace variable
symptoms: Alert 'api-gateway 429 rate > 2%' on /v2/search only. Live Kong rate-limit shows 60 rpm; git says 600 rpm. Same shape as INC-013.
root_cause: terraform apply was run from the staging workspace, whose rate_limit_per_minute variable overrode production. Second occurrence of the config-drift class after INC-013.
resolution_steps: Diff live Kong plugin config against git
terraform workspace select prod && terraform apply
Add a CI check that fails plan if workspace != target environment
Confirm 429s return to baseline
lesson: Recurrence of INC-013. Rate-limit drift on one route = config change; check git and the workspace first.

title: Orders stuck in PENDING - Kafka broker disk full
symptoms: Alert 'orders in PENDING > 15 min: 1,400'. Producer logs: 'TimeoutException: Expiring 120 record(s) for orders-events-3' and 'NotLeaderOrFollowerException'. Broker kafka-2 disk at 100%.
root_cause: A debug topic created during INC-027 had unlimited retention and filled kafka-2's disk; partitions led by kafka-2 stopped accepting writes.
resolution_steps: kafka-topics --describe shows under-replicated partitions on kafka-2
Delete the debug topic and set retention.bytes=10GB on all topics
Restart broker kafka-2 and wait for ISR to recover
Replay stuck orders: scripts/replay_pending_orders.py
failed_attempts: Restarting order-service producers - the broker, not the client, was the problem
lesson: Every topic needs a retention limit; temporary debug topics need an owner and an expiry.

title: SSR 500s at 09:00 UTC - scheduled feature-flag rollout
symptoms: Alert 'checkout-web error rate > 20%' starting exactly 08:58 UTC. Sentry: 'ReferenceError: window is not defined' in NewHeader during server-side render. No deploy in 14 hours.
root_cause: LaunchDarkly scheduled rollout moved ssr_new_header from 0% to 50% at 08:58; the component accessed window at module scope, which crashes on the server.
resolution_steps: Check LaunchDarkly audit log for changes in the last 30 minutes (lesson from INC-036)
Set ssr_new_header to 0%
Guard window access with typeof window !== 'undefined' and redeploy later
lesson: Applying the INC-036 lesson (flag audit log first when there is no deploy) cut resolution from 18 minutes to 6.
